Module 8 — Emotional Arc Design

Apply the Six Phase Cathartic Arc to build emotionally coherent and evidence aware class experiences.

This module introduces the original methodology contribution of this handbook: the Six Phase Cathartic Arc.

Why this module exists

Arc design translates theory into lived sequence. Without clear arc logic, classes oscillate between monotony and chaos.

Six Phase Cathartic Arc

| Phase | Purpose | Duration | Music | Cueing | Somatic target | |—|—|—|—|—|—| | Arrival and Orientation | Establish safety and baseline | 6 to 10 min | Warm low arousal | Grounding invitational | Breath and contact awareness | | Activation and Mobilization | Build heat and commitment | 8 to 12 min | Rising pulse | Specific rhythmic | Joint prep and core readiness | | Escalation and Edge | Expand challenge | 10 to 14 min | Driving groove | Short direct options | Effort tolerance and coordination | | Cathartic Peak | Focused expressive output | 8 to 12 min | High energy | Sparse potent containment | Whole body intensity and agency | | Integration and Downshift | Restore coherence | 10 to 14 min | Softened texture | Interoceptive reflective | Down regulation and breath length | | Landing and Meaning | Consolidate and close | 6 to 10 min | Spacious minimal | Quiet precise | Parasympathetic settling |

What the evidence actually says

The arc is a design framework, not a guaranteed emotional outcome. Catharsis helps some participants and destabilizes others. Option-rich cueing and clear scaling are non-negotiable.

Practicum

  1. Map your current class to six phases.
  2. Identify one mismatch per phase.
  3. Build alternate low energy and high energy versions.
  4. Pilot twice and compare outcomes.

Deliverable

Create a Six Phase Arc Blueprint with timestamps, score choices, cue skeleton, and risk controls.
